highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 renderer with upstream engine fixes.
highlights_body: Linux font fallback can select a different fontconfig face after this update, so applications requiring deterministic typography should choose an explicit or bundled typeface.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort path, which can change fallback glyphs or text metrics. Use an explicit family and style, or a bundled typeface, when deterministic font selection matters.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 153 and includes its upstream bug-fix sync.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 renderer and its upstream fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 prepared the m153 preview line for validation.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: The preview includes the current upstream engine fixes and may select a different Linux font fallback face.
